Indian Sugar & Bio-Energy Manufacturers Association noted various climatic factors affecting sugar crops across key states.

title: Huang is back to corner office via couch: Tech boss talks therapy after return as CEO

He has come forward to admit violations of the company’s code of conduct, including multiple relationships. His approach to management has been under fire, particularly concerning Nvidia's ties with China. As political scrutiny mounts over his return, investigations into the company’s practices are ongoing.

The turnout exceeded the expected four lakh guests, leading to severe traffic issues. A horse race contributed to an increase in spectators during the wedding festivities. Over 150 varieties of food and sweets were prepared for guests, reflecting the grand scale of the celebration. Prominent personalities and political leaders participated, further emphasizing the wedding's significance.

title: Rupee recovers FY26 losses, strengthens to 92.16 against dollar on equity rally
description: On Wednesday, the Indian rupee strengthened against the US dollar, closing at 92.16 after substantial gains. This increase followed significant foreign institutional investments exceeding $12 billion into Indian equities during November. Weaker crude oil prices and robust domestic equity markets contributed to the rupee's recovery. The Reserve Bank of India reported net dollar purchases, supporting the currency's stability. Analysts expect continued positive trends based on these favorable economic indicators.

title: 25% penalty or 17% 'relief' with rider: What Trump's new tariff threat means for India
description: The Donald Trump administration's move assumes significance because the India-US trade deal is yet to be finalised.  Up to 25% tariffs on all goods from India, net of existing Section 301 tariffs, with exemptions for certain goods would be applicable, but there is also the prospect of 17% tariffs if a trade deal is agreed on.

title: Musk says 'impressive work by Google', as CEO Pichai shares Neon's new Day record
description: Elon Musk has publicly praised Google's recent advancements in artificial intelligence, highlighting their Neon model and Antigravity platform. Sundar Pichai shared updates on Neon's new Day-1 usage record as well as the increase in Antigravity token usage. The daily token usage surged by 82% following the launch of Argon just six weeks ago. Pichai expressed gratitude for the feedback received from users about the models.

title: Wiaan Mulder becomes first player to score triple ton and take 7-wicket haul
description: Wiaan Mulder made history in Test cricket by not only scoring a remarkable 367 runs against Zimbabwe but also taking 7 wickets for just 31 runs against Bangladesh. This stellar performance in Centurion not only led South Africa to a dominating innings victory but also secured a 2-0 series win. Furthermore, his achievement of the fastest seven-wicket haul by a fourth-change bowler in Test history adds to his impressive credentials.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ foundation received $1.7 million from 28 funders
description: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ 15 and the Mahomies received over a million from over 25 funders for their foundation between 2019 and 2025. Kansas City Chiefs owner Clark Hunt’s foundation and the league foundation are some of the funders who believe in Chiefs ace quarterback Patrick Mahomes’ vision for underserved children.

title: 'No significant impact on India': MeitY secretary on US chip export curbs
description: S. Krishnan, secretary of MeitY, reassured that the recent US chip export restrictions won't impact India. He stated that India is appreciated as a reliable partner in data centre technology. In addition, over 200 companies have expressed interest in the India Semiconductor Mission 2.0. Krishnan also mentioned the exciting advancements of Chariot One, an innovative text-to-speech AI model developed by Indian graduates, showcasing India's technological prowess.

title: US economy expands at 4.3% annualised rate in Q3, nearly double Q2 growth
description: The US economy grew at a surprising annualised rate of 4.3% in the third quarter of 2026. This growth was significantly bolstered by stronger consumer spending and robust business investment during that period. Consumer spending rose at a revised rate of 4.2%, while business investment continued its upward trajectory. Despite these positive figures, the rise in corporate profits showed a slowdown compared to the previous quarter.

title: 5 Maharashtra districts face fast-building flash droughts; Beed, Solapur among hotspots
description: Maharashtra has identified five districts as hotspots for flash droughts due to extreme drying risks. Research indicates that these districts can experience severe moisture loss in just a few weeks. The pre-monsoon period shows the highest vulnerability, especially following a deficient monsoon. Current monitoring systems emphasize the need to integrate temperature and soil moisture data effectively. Farmers and authorities are urged to prepare for potentially hotter and drier pre-monsoon conditions.

title: Deport 'illegal Muslim infiltrators', Hindus fleeing B'desh 'refugees': CM Suvendu
description: Suvendu Adhikari, the chief minister of West Bengal, instructed police to trace illegal Muslim immigrants while providing refuge for Hindus. He emphasized the need for coordination with the Border Security Force to strengthen border security measures. Adhikari also highlighted efforts to combat illegal activities like drug trafficking and smuggling. Additionally, he warned against violence towards women and insisted on enforcing animal protection laws.

title: Man flying to India for spine surgery dies after Air India denies boarding
description: Air India has been directed to compensate Rs 25 lakh to a grieving widow after her husband was refused boarding. William Fernandez, a nurse, experienced a medical crisis while traveling to Mangalore for surgery. Despite holding a confirmed business-class reservation, the flight was oversold. Tragically, he collapsed and passed away the following day after spending a night in a hotel.

title: Meta executives meet Congress amid protests over content restrictions

description: Mokama MLA Anant Singh is preparing for an extravagant wedding for his daughter Shivangi on November 25. The celebrations will feature five helipads for VIP guests and a horse race with an SUV as the top prize. A lavish feast is planned for about four lakh guests, featuring 150 varieties of food. A Jaipur-inspired wedding pavilion is being built, along with elaborate floral decorations.

title: Chhattisgarh HC cuts doctor's accident compensation by Rs 12 lakh over tax error
description: The Chhattisgarh High Court has adjusted the compensation awarded to the family of a deceased doctor following errors in income tax assessments by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal. Indrajeet Singh Siddhu, who lost his life in a road accident in 2017, saw the court maintain a 30% increase for future prospects despite the insurance company's objections. The revised total compensation stands at Rs 2,37,33,211, including interest.

title: 3 Chinese satellites scanned India's western coast during Op Sindoor: Report
description: In 2022, during Operation Sindoor, three Chinese surveillance satellites meticulously monitored India's western coast, specifically focusing on Gujarat. These satellites closely tracked military installations and vital facilities like the Jamnagar refinery owned by Reliance. By adjusting their orbits, they optimized their capacity to observe military activities, especially during a brief four-day period of heightened tensions.

title: Bezos’ ex-wife gave $62M landmark gift to meet 2030 goals of coastal communities
description: MacKenzie Scott has donated $62 million to the marine conservation organization Blue Ventures for their 2030 goals. This donation will support small-scale fishing communities and their efforts in marine ecosystem conservation. The funding aims to enhance local stewardship of carbon-rich seas and improve food security in coastal areas. Blue Ventures will allocate funds through the Frontline Community Fund to empower local partners effectively.
